items: Sodium Hypochlorite must be stores away form heat and sunlight.
Sodium Hypochlorite is diluted by demi-water to avoid precipitation.

Sodium Hypochlorite is avoided mixing with acid and FeC13 to prevent rapid 
 generation of chlorine gas.
Wearing safety clothes and tools when contact with it.
Oxygen cylinder must be near to preparation area.
Loading 60l concentrated NaOC1 to be dilated in dilution tank (300l).
Check the concentration by using hydrometer after dilution.
Inject NaOC1 to raw water line by using diaphragm pump (capacity 10l/hr).

Dosing of Sodium Hypochlorite in Clarifier
Introduction
Sodium hypochlorite is chlorine derivatives formed by reaction of chlorine with 
hydroxide. Sodium hypochlorite as chlorine gas is used for:
Disinfections,
Control of microorganism,
Control of taste and odor,
Color reduction and
Destruction of organic matter.
